items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the Picard group exact sequence for glueing two points, with the vanishing and injectivity alternatives (statement lines 3323-3331). The proof (lines 3333-3359) is complete: surjectivity from the birational-finite lemma, the units exact sequence with the Leray bound identifying the kernel as the cokernel of ab^{-1}, and the two cases dispatched by component analysis and the scalar-valued regular functions. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a standard cohomological bookkeeping with a clean two-case ending.
